map.根据混淆矩阵计算分类准确率。: Compute classification accuracy from the confusion matrix.
map.分类模型最直观的整体判对比例。它隐含\"各类代价相同\"的假设，当负样本占绝大多: The most intuitive overall correct-rate of a classifier. It implicitly assumes equal cost per class; when negatives dominate (e.g. 99:1 fraud detection), always predicting negative gives 99% accuracy yet no value, so it must be read together with precision, recall or MCC.
map.类别不均衡时准确率易误导，应结合其他指标。: Accuracy misleads under class imbalance; combine with other metrics.
map.整体准确率=(正确预测数)/(总样本数)，按混淆矩阵 TP+TN 之和计算。: Overall accuracy = (correct predictions)/(total samples), from the sum TP+TN in the confusion matrix.
map.各类别正确率=该类别预测正确数/该类别样本数，揭示对少数类的表现。: Per-class accuracy = correct predictions for that class / samples of that class, revealing performance on minority classes.
map.类别不平衡时整体准确率易虚高，需结合宏/微平均与混淆矩阵解读。: Under class imbalance overall accuracy easily inflates; interpret with macro/micro average and the confusion matrix.
map.三类各 100 样本，A 类对 90、B 类对 80、C 类对 60 → 整体准: Three classes of 100 samples each, A correct 90, B 80, C 60 -> overall accuracy = (90+80+60)/300 = 76.7%; per-class 90%/80%/60%, showing the model is weakest on C.
map.整体准确率高但某类很差是正常的吗？: Is high overall accuracy with one weak class normal?
map.在不平衡或多类场景中常见，说明模型偏向多数/易分样本。应报告各类别准确率与混淆矩: Common in imbalanced or multi-class settings, meaning the model favors majority/easy samples. Report per-class accuracy and the confusion matrix, not just the overall number.
map.准确率和 F1 冲突听谁的？: When accuracy and F1 conflict, which wins?
map.看业务代价。若漏检/误判代价高(医疗、风控)，优先看精确率/召回/F1 与具体类: It depends on business cost. If missed/false judgments are costly (medical, risk control), prioritize precision/recall/F1 and per-class metrics over overall accuracy.
map.分类准确率（本页代码口径）：准确率=(真阳性 TP+真阴性 TN)÷(TP+TN: Classification accuracy (this page's code): accuracy=(true positives TP+true negatives TN)÷(TP+TN+false positives FP+false negatives FN)×100 (%), kept to 2 decimals. Validation: no strict checks; empty values count as 0; all four zero makes the denominator 0 and triggers "Some results are undefined (zero denominator or empty input)". Grading: no fixed tiers; 100% accuracy means everything outside the confusion-matrix diagonal is 0.
map.混淆矩阵判读（与上方公式互补，同一组四格输入）：TP/FN 刻画真实正类被判对/: Confusion-matrix interpretation (complementary to the formula above, same four-cell input): TP/FN describe true positives correctly detected/missed, TN/FP describe true negatives correctly cleared/false alarms; this page only outputs overall accuracy — derived metrics such as precision and recall are not computed here (definitions: precision=TP÷(TP+FP), recall=TP÷(TP+FN)); under class imbalance a high accuracy does not necessarily mean good positive-class detection. Validation: same as above; empty values count as 0. Grading: no fixed tiers.
